responsibility: Implements a memory-backed stream device within the generic gm2 channel framework. It allocates a device id and per-channel MemInfo records through RTdata, provides generic text/raw device hooks via RTgen and RTgenif, manages buffer pointers, lengths, indices, optional reallocation and deallocation on close, supports resetting read/write positions with Reread and Rewrite, and produces ChanId streams that behave like in-memory files for higher-level ISO I/O code.
same_name_distinction: This .mod file is the implementation half of the MemStream pair: rather than just declaring the API like MemStream.def, it builds the in-memory channel device, manages MemInfo records through RTdata, installs RTgen/RTgenif callbacks, and performs buffer allocation, resizing, indexing, and close/reset behavior.
